statement: LeanCTX provides the broadest single-binary compression surface (read modes, shell, wire proxy, MCP) among the five tools.
RTK is the deepest standalone shell-output compressor with 14+ host integrations; LeanCTX composes RTK as addon rather than replacing it.
Context Mode is the only tool with documented hook-level WebFetch deny and CTX_FETCH_STRICT SSRF modes.
Context Mode PreCompact session recovery has no direct equivalent in RTK, agentmemory, or Graphify.
agentmemory provides the richest agent-orchestration memory surface (actions, leases, sentinels, mesh) not replicated by LeanCTX ctx_agent alone.
Graphify is the dedicated code+docs knowledge graph with god nodes, Leiden communities, and multimodal vision ingest.
LeanCTX Ed25519 savings ledger is unique; RTK/CM/agentmemory/Graphify lack cryptographic batch-verifiable token economics.
LeanCTX gap: no first-class PreCompact hook parity with Context Mode.
LeanCTX gap: agentmemory-style multi-agent action DAG, sentinel, and mesh tooling.
LeanCTX gap: Graphify-grade multimodal corpus graph (vision on arbitrary images, Karpathy /raw workflow) as primary product center.
